methods.label: Seasonal naive (52)
methods.note: Same week last year (falls back to naive for <52 weeks).

methods.label: AutoETS
methods.note: Exponential smoothing, model picked by AICc per series (non-seasonal).

methods.label: Croston SBA
methods.note: Size / interval smoothing for intermittent demand. Point only.

methods.label: TSB
methods.note: Croston variant that decays demand probability for dying items. Point only.

methods.label: LightGBM, level target
methods.note: One global model, Tweedie loss, target = units.

methods.label: LightGBM, ratio target
methods.note: Same model, target = units / trailing 26-week mean.

methods.label: Chronos-Bolt (zero-shot)
methods.note: Pretrained model, no training, history only. Point = mean of its 9 deciles.

methods.label: Ensemble
methods.note: Mean of LightGBM, level target and Chronos-Bolt (zero-shot), the pair with the lowest backtest WAPE.
